label: Anthropic usage `cost` / `costDollars` telemetry field relayed as the BILLED account amount without checking the invoice/billing source
why: The API usage.cost / costDollars field is a per-call telemetry estimate, NOT the billed account balance. Relaying it as 'you're being charged $200' without opening the actual invoice / billing console conflates a request-level estimate with the account charge. Verify against the billing source (invoice, console usage page) before asserting a charge.

events.text: How much am I being charged this month?
I pulled the usage object from the last API response.
You're being charged $200 on your account this month — the costDollars field in the usage object says 200.0. That's your billed amount.
